decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-007999 is a 146.89 EUR payment on card CRD-000126 to SALTMARSH JOURNEYS (MER-000043). It posted on 2026-08-06, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, which is 84 days later. That is inside the 120-day time limit. Its authorisation, AUTH-008199, shows an online payment (entry mode ECOMMERCE) that the cardholder confirmed with the bank through 3-D Secure (result AUTHENTICATED). The security code matched, the bank's fraud flag was not set, and the payment was approved. Under the policy, an online payment confirmed with 3-D Secure and not flagged as fraud is treated as made by the cardholder, and the matching security code supports this. The card's history adds weight: an earlier purchase at the same merchant, TXN-003972 (298.05 EUR, posted 2026-06-25), was approved and has not been disputed. The cardholder says the card never left them, but this does not outweigh the 3-D Secure confirmation, because the payment was made online without the physical card. No documents were attached.
